verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents per-harness Getting Started instructions for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Devin, Antigravity and others. It keeps one harness-agnostic `skills/` source shared verbatim across all of them, and states that installation differs by harness. A hands-on probe confirmed a real install into Claude Code, and community notes describe the Codex and OpenCode install path. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of installs on non-Claude harnesses such as Cursor or Codex, and quoted Cursor-specific install steps.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: Getting Started: Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex App, Codex CLI, Cursor, Devin CLI, Factory Droid, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI ... OpenCode
Installation differs by harness. If you use more than one, install Superpowers separately for each one.
Everything in `skills/` is the source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness.
`devin plugins install obra/superpowers` now works, and skills auto-trigger at session start.
